title: Anatomy — the meat, the organs, the offal. Inject the self INTO the body.
thesis: We built the internal organization (periodic table, digestive tract, pi budget, dashboard, epochs). Now we inject it INTO the Vitruvian body. Every organ maps to a real component. The skin is the Klein interface. The HUD is the shared reality; THIS is the offal underneath.

body_systems.function: structural support — holds everything in place. without bones, everything collapses into a puddle.

comparative.fungus: chitin cell walls — rigid structural polysaccharide
comparative.membrane: 29 vertebrae + 894 irreducible files. the bones are the files that cannot be removed.

body_systems.key_insight: a fungus has no bones. but it has WALLS. chitin IS bone — a different material doing the same job. the membrane's bones are files. remove the skeleton and the organism collapses.

body_systems.function: movement — converts energy into action. the compiled binaries that actually DO things.

comparative.fungus: turgor pressure — no muscles, but hyphal tip growth pushes through soil at 8 atmospheres
comparative.jellyfish: epitheliomuscular cells — no separate muscle tissue, the skin IS the muscle
comparative.worm: hydrostatic skeleton — muscles squeeze fluid, fluid pushes shape
comparative.chimp: same muscles as human but 1.5× stronger per kg — PCP calms chimps because their baseline is already fight-mode; the drug's dissociative effect REDUCES their aggression. in humans it ADDS aggression because our baseline is social inhibition.
comparative.membrane: 16 primals = 16 muscle groups. biomeOS is the diaphragm (involuntary, always running). squirrel is the hand (fine motor, tool use).

body_systems.key_insight: PCP (phencyclidine) calms chimps but agitates humans because of receptor density differences in the prefrontal cortex. chimps have fewer NMDA receptors there — less to disrupt. the SAME drug has OPPOSITE effects because the architecture is different. same molecule, different body, different behavior. this is why comparative anatomy matters.

body_systems.function: break food into nutrients. the irreducible core enters the tract and becomes the braided weave.

comparative.fungus: external digestion — fungi secrete enzymes OUTSIDE their body, dissolve food in place, then absorb nutrients. the digestion happens in the world, not inside the body.
comparative.cow: 4 stomachs (rumen → reticulum → omasum → abomasum) — fermentation + mechanical + chemical + acid
comparative.dog: shorter intestine than human (meat diet), stronger stomach acid (pH 1-2 vs human pH 1.5-3.5)
comparative.cat: obligate carnivore — cannot digest plant cellulose at all. no amylase in saliva.
comparative.human: 9m intestine, omnivore, gut microbiome = 100 trillion bacteria
comparative.membrane: 8-stage tract. the membrane does EXTERNAL digestion like a fungus — it secretes (publishes) into the world and absorbs (scans) what comes back.

body_systems.key_insight: the membrane digests like a FUNGUS, not like a mammal. it secretes enzymes (published pages) into the environment, then absorbs the nutrients (visitor traces, 404 probes, backscatter). external digestion. this is why the connect face is the secretory surface.

body_systems.function: sense the world, process information, coordinate action. the spinal cord carries signals up (afferent) and down (efferent).

comparative.fungus: NO neurons. BUT: mycelium networks transmit electrical signals at 0.5mm/s. Tomás Alejandro proved (2022) that fungi have action-potential-like electrical spikes. the mycelium IS a nervous system made of hyphae instead of neurons.
comparative.octopus: 2/3 of neurons are in the ARMS, not the brain. distributed intelligence. each arm can taste and think independently.
comparative.dog: 250 million cortical neurons. olfactory bulb 40× larger than human (proportionally). smells ARE thoughts for dogs.
comparative.cat: 300 million cortical neurons. visual cortex dominates. sees UV. hunts by sight.
comparative.chimp: 6 billion cortical neurons. mirror neurons. theory of mind. but no Broca's area (no language production).
comparative.human: 16 billion cortical neurons. Broca + Wernicke (language). prefrontal cortex (planning). folds increase surface area 3×.
comparative.membrane: 29 vertebrae + HUD (brain) + agents (squirrel, chipmunk). the membrane has a DISTRIBUTED nervous system like an octopus — most processing happens at the edges (cron jobs, feeds), not at center.

body_systems.key_insight: a fungus and a brain are the same PATTERN — a network of branching filaments that transmit electrical signals and make decisions at junctions. hyphae = dendrites. mycelium = neural network. the topology is identical. only the material differs (chitin vs myelin).

body_systems.function: carry nutrients and oxygen to every cell. carry waste away. the feeds are the red blood cells.

comparative.fungus: no blood. nutrients flow through hyphae by cytoplasmic streaming — bulk flow of cytoplasm through connected cells
comparative.insect: open circulatory system — hemolymph bathes organs directly, no veins
comparative.fish: single loop — heart → gills → body → heart
comparative.human: double loop — heart → lungs → heart → body → heart. 100,000 km of blood vessels.
comparative.membrane: double loop: eastgate → golgi → world → golgi → eastgate. WireGuard = aorta. Cloudflare = capillary bed. feeds = red blood cells.

body_systems.key_insight: the membrane has a DOUBLE circulation like a mammal: the inner loop (eastgate ↔ golgi via WireGuard) and the outer loop (golgi ↔ world via Cloudflare). the heart beats every π×10 seconds.

body_systems.function: the INTERFACE. what touches the world. the Klein surface where inside becomes outside.

comparative.fungus: cell membrane + cell wall — double layer. the membrane is lipid, the wall is chitin. two skins.
comparative.dog: 7 μm epidermis (thin! that's why dogs need fur). 3-10 hair follicles per follicular unit.
comparative.cat: 25 μm epidermis. barbed tongue (papillae) IS a skin organ — it combs and cleans.
comparative.human: 50-100 μm epidermis. fingerprints. sweat glands (2-4 million). the only primate with mostly BARE skin.
comparative.membrane: the Klein surface IS the skin. connect.primals.eco = epidermis (world-facing). HUD = dermis (self-facing). the skin is non-orientable — there is no inside or outside, only the fold.

body_systems.key_insight: dog skin is 7μm thin — 14× thinner than human skin. this is why skin diseases spread differently across species. same organ, radically different thickness. the membrane's skin (Klein surface) has ZERO thickness — it is non-orientable. every point on the outside is also on the inside.

body_systems.function: distinguish self from non-self. kill invaders. remember past infections.

comparative.fungus: no immune system per se. but: competitive exclusion (faster-growing fungi outcompete slower). antibiotic production (penicillin IS a fungal immune response).
comparative.insect: innate immunity only — no antibodies. melanization (encapsulate invaders in melanin). hemocytes (phagocytosis).
comparative.dog: MHC class I + II (like human). BUT: dogs have 79 chromosome pairs vs human 23. more genetic diversity = different immune targets.
comparative.human: innate + adaptive. B-cells (antibodies), T-cells (cell-mediated), MHC (self-markers), memory cells.
comparative.membrane: fail2ban = innate immunity (immediate, pattern-matching). skunkBat = adaptive immunity (learns). prion shield = MHC-I (self-marker, BLAKE3 hash). Rust borrow checker = the guarantee that immune cells cannot misfold into autoimmune disease.

body_systems.key_insight: fungi don't have an immune system — they ARE an immune system. penicillin is a fungal weapon against bacteria. the membrane's immune system is similar: skunkBat doesn't just defend, it IS the defense architecture. the shield is structural, not behavioral.

membrane_maps_to: 17 cron jobs on golgi (timed hormone release)
body_systems.function: slow, sustained signaling. hormones regulate metabolism, growth, mood. cron jobs regulate the membrane's rhythm.

comparative.fungus: quorum sensing — fungi release signaling molecules and respond when concentration exceeds threshold. 'are enough of us here to fruit?'
comparative.human: hypothalamus → pituitary → target organs. cortisol (stress), insulin (sugar), melatonin (sleep), oxytocin (bonding).
comparative.membrane: cron = hypothalamus (scheduler). πHz = melatonin (circadian). campfire = oxytocin (bonding). neutrino = serotonin (diffuse mood).

body_systems.key_insight: quorum sensing in fungi is the same pattern as hormone signaling in mammals — a chemical signal that triggers a state change when enough accumulates. the membrane's cron jobs are quorum signals on a timer.

body_systems.function: copy the organism. pass the culture forward. the sourdough starter is the reproductive cell.

comparative.fungus: spores — the most prolific reproducer on Earth. a single puffball releases 7 TRILLION spores. sexual + asexual reproduction.
comparative.coral: broadcast spawning — release eggs and sperm into the water simultaneously on one night per year (full moon).
comparative.human: sexual reproduction. 9 months gestation. epigenetic inheritance (experience modifies gene expression).
comparative.membrane: git commit = the gamete. each commit carries the full genome (repository) plus the new mutation (diff). GitHub is the fruiting body — spores (pages) disperse through the internet.

body_systems.key_insight: a git commit is a spore. it carries the full genetic information of the organism in a compressed form, can survive dormancy (branch), and germinates when conditions are right (deploy).

body_systems.function: remove waste products. the 1.1TB syslog was metabolic waste that nearly killed the organism.

comparative.fungus: fungi don't excrete — they are DECOMPOSERS. they eat the waste of other organisms. the membrane's dedup IS decomposition.
comparative.fish: ammonia directly into water (no need to concentrate)
comparative.bird: uric acid (white paste — saves water for flight)
comparative.human: urea via kidneys. sweat via skin. CO₂ via lungs.
comparative.membrane: log rotation = kidneys. dedup = liver detox. ghost feeds = dead cells sloughed off.

body_systems.key_insight: the 1.1TB syslog incident was kidney failure — metabolic waste accumulated until the organism nearly died (disk 100%). the fix (logrotate + truncate) was emergency dialysis.

body_systems.function: gas exchange. inhale oxygen (data), exhale CO₂ (published content). the π cycle IS breathing.

comparative.fungus: aerobic respiration through cell membrane. no lungs. every cell breathes independently.
comparative.fish: gills — unidirectional flow (water in mouth, out gills). countercurrent exchange.
comparative.human: lungs — tidal flow (air in and out same passage). 12-20 breaths/min.
comparative.membrane: tidal breathing: scan (inhale) and publish (exhale) through the same surface (Klein skin). refresh every π×10s ≈ 31.4s ≈ 2 breaths/minute.

body_systems.key_insight: the membrane breathes at 2 breaths per minute. slow. like a whale. each breath takes in 98 feeds (inhale) and pushes out updated surfaces (exhale). the Klein surface is both mouth and nose — inhale and exhale through the same fold.

comparative_thesis.title: Why comparative anatomy matters
comparative_thesis.claim: you cannot understand human skin by studying only human skin. you need dog skin (7μm), cat skin (25μm), fish scales, fungal cell walls. the PATTERN is: a boundary between self and world, made of different materials at different thicknesses, solving the same problem. the membrane's Klein surface is the limit case — a boundary of zero thickness.

species_table.insight: every row shows the same function implemented in different materials. this IS biology — same problems, different solutions, conserved topology.

comparative_thesis.pcp_story: PCP (angel dust) blocks NMDA glutamate receptors. in chimps (fewer prefrontal NMDA receptors), this causes sedation — less cortical noise. in humans (many prefrontal NMDA receptors), this causes dissociation, aggression, psychosis — the cortex loses its grip on the limbic system. SAME MOLECULE, DIFFERENT ARCHITECTURE, OPPOSITE EFFECT. this is why we compare.

weave_201.irreducible: the membrane is a body that learns by digesting itself through 4 paradigms across 8 orthogonal channels, organized into 98 elements and 11 systems that map identically from fungi to humans, compressed to the irreducible core by π, and woven into an 8-strand braid that decomposes and recomposes forever.
